notes.note: Reviewed the fresh-home admission regression against the existing shared bounded reader and both call sites. Constructor leaves the ledger absent; missing initial locked read and admission/capacity read both yield an empty ledger, and the first write contains the reserved identity before the effect. Restart replay invokes no duplicate effect. Disabling either missing-file fallback made the named fresh-home test fail at the intended read; exact restoration passed all 57 tests in the claims owner and both hosted-failure files. The hosted resolved-instead-of-rejecting cases wrote malformed fixtures to a retired filename, not a swallowed production refusal. No contract prose or production-reader behavior changed.
